recent_news.headline: How Does a Grease Vacuum Truck Collect and Transport Waste?
recent_news.summary: Educational overview of grease vacuum truck operations, pumping requirements (30–90 days depending on jurisdiction), and the role of these vehicles in handling FOG waste from food service establishments.

backfill_news.headline: ESG Regulations in the Food Sector: The 2026 Compliance Guide
backfill_news.summary: Guide detailing ESG compliance requirements for food operators, including waste reporting standards under CSRD/ESRS E5 and SASB Food & Beverage standards that mandate tracking of food waste generation and diversion rates.

backfill_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Sets Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release for October 29
backfill_news.summary: Darling Ingredients (NYSE: DAR) announced it will release Q3 2026 financial results and host a conference call on October 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET.
